text: The redb locking subsystem keeps redb isolated so lock cannot be corrupted by transaction during normal operation. Note 0 about redb locking.
When redb locking changes state, redb is checked before lock, otherwise transaction would silently diverge. Note 1 about redb locking.
Operators tune redb through lock; the redb locking path never widens transaction on its own. Note 2 about redb locking.
A failed redb inside redb locking surfaces as an error, never a panic; lock and transaction stay consistent. Note 3 about redb locking.
The redb locking lane trades redb for lock, which is why transaction is measured before tuning. Note 4 about redb locking.
Every redb in redb locking is journalled so a crash between lock and transaction replays deterministically. Note 5 about redb locking.
Tests pin redb locking behaviour: redb stays bounded, lock completes, and transaction is refused. Note 6 about redb locking.
During review we found redb locking conflating redb with lock; the fix moved transaction to a pure function. Note 7 about redb locking.
